select convert(varchar,max(date)) from d360.LOG_TBL where file_name like '%ATM%'


SELECT  [ACID]
,*
 FROM [syn].[STG_CORE_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER] order by 1

 select acid from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER order by 1

 select count(*), FILE_NAME from d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS where H = 'D'
 group by FILE_NAME

 select count(*)  from d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS where H = 'D'


 select * from d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS where H <> 'D'


 select count(*) from syn.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB 
 select  count(*) from d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB 


 SELECT DISTINCT d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CUST_ID,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CIF_NO,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.FIRST_NM,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.MIDDLE_NM,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.LAST_NM,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.EMAIL,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.COUNTRY_CD,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.STATUS,
d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.USER_ID,
--d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.ACCT_NO,
--d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.ACCT_TYPE_ID,
d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTID
--d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.BANK_CODE
FROM   d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB
LEFT OUTER JOIN d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS
ON d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CIF_NO = d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY
WHERE  ( d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.CIF_NO IS NOT NULL )
AND ( d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY IS NULL )
--AND ( d360.STG_MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB.BANK_CODE = N'CBC01' )








-- Monitor active queries
SELECT *
FROM sys.dm_pdw_exec_requests
WHERE status not in ('Completed','Failed','Cancelled')
  AND session_id <> session_id()
ORDER BY submit_time DESC;

-- Find top 10 queries longest running queries
SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM sys.dm_pdw_exec_requests
ORDER BY total_elapsed_time DESC;


select count(*) Count_tgt,  sum(convert(float,AMOUNT1)) AMOUNT1, file_name, insert_dttm from d360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS where H = 'D'
group by file_name, insert_dttm
